title: add_yaml_field
description: Adds or overwrites a field at a specified path within a YAML file.

file_path.description: Relative or absolute path to the YAML file to modify (e.g. 'config/app.yaml', 'k8s/deployment.yaml').

field_path.description: Dot-separated path to the field within the YAML document (e.g. 'spec.replicas', 'metadata.labels.app').

value.description: The value to set at the specified field path. Complex values should be serialized as a YAML or JSON string.
